mechanism: Brimonidine is an alpha-2 adrenergic agonist that can cause CNS depression and sedation, which may be additive with cenobamate's CNS depressant effects; cenobamate also induces CYP3A4 which could theoretically affect brimonidine metabolism.
action: Monitor for increased CNS depression (drowsiness, fatigue) and counsel patient to avoid driving or hazardous activities; systemic absorption of ophthalmic brimonidine is generally minimal but caution is warranted.
